name: True North Sailing Charters

reviews.author: Sue
reviews.text: We booked a private water taxi ride and Captain Abe was wonderful. Easy booking, a beautiful ride across the bay, and great local knowledge. A perfect way to get out on the water.

reviews.author: Stacy Anderson
reviews.text: Sailed on Starling with Dusty and had an amazing afternoon. The boat is beautiful, the crew made everyone feel comfortable, and the views of the Apostle Islands were unforgettable.

reviews.author: Kim Olson
reviews.text: Our sail with Dusty was the highlight of our Bayfield trip. Relaxing, scenic, and just the right amount of sailing lore. We would absolutely do it again.

reviews.author: Kim Bacon
reviews.text: Island hopping with Captain Weston was fantastic. We saw sea caves, lighthouses, and had plenty of time to explore. The whole day was well run from start to finish.

reviews.author: Jada Pfarr
reviews.text: Starling with Dusty and First Mate Riley was such a fun sail. Friendly crew, gorgeous boat, and a great introduction to sailing on Lake Superior. Highly recommend.
